stem: A dense plant has strong light at the upper canopy but shaded interior growth and uneven development. Which explanation best fits canopy-science evidence?
choices: Plant architecture can create gradients in light and microclimate, so canopy structure should be considered when interpreting uneven development
All parts of a plant receive identical light whenever the fixture is centered
Interior development is controlled only by cultivar name
Canopy architecture cannot influence chemical or biomass distribution
rationale: Plant architecture affects light penetration and canopy microclimate, which can contribute to spatial differences in biomass and chemical composition.
